_source: Godot: LastRoute Godot/KyttusLabApp/game/config/player_models.gd (one body for every runner); rig and bone names from assets/hunters_blocky/player_mannequin/player_mannequin.bbmodel. Poses come from the player rig's clips (render/anim/clip.rs), not from a swing table.

runner._height: audit P13: the head top is head_top_units up and one unit is 1.067/64 m, so the figure is 1.90 m tall.
runner._clips: Which clip each state plays, its pace, the crouch fade and the swim lean are data/player/anim.json (render/anim/runner.rs); this file holds the body, its height and the bots.

bots._source: Rust-only: NPC teammates (game/npc.rs) wear the runner mannequin and the same clips; the skin is picked from `skins` by a hash of the guest name. state_for_speed: a bot's state comes from how fast its position changed (metres per second).
